messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. (also matched: prescription_error) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Prescription transmitted with incorrect medication strength

Dear Support Team, I am writing to report a serious transmission error regarding a prescription sent for patient J.D. earlier this morning. The medication was selected correctly in the chart, but the system populated an incorrect dosage strength upon transmission to the retail pharmacy. We have already contacted the pharmacist to halt dispensing, and we request your assistance in reviewing the transmission logs to understand how this substitution occurred.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for bringing this prescription transmission issue to our attention. We understand the seriousness of an incorrect medication strength being sent to the pharmacy and appreciate the steps you have already taken with the pharmacist.

A member of our support team is now reviewing the transmission logs and investigating how the substitution occurred. We will keep you informed as soon as we have more information.

If you have any additional details that might help our investigation, please feel free to share them.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this matter.

Sincerely,
[Support Team]"
}
